temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and talkative, so her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Carolyn learns that Marilyn's quietness is connected to being overwhelmed by work and personal issues, rather than simply being distant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant stress and may need support, but she is willing to acknowledge it when asked.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To check in on Marilyn, offer support, and remain available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed and may need support, but her curtness makes Carolyn unsure whether she overstepped or whether Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Carolyn learns that Marilyn's curtness was due to a hard week, not personal rejection, and that Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn, is receptive to support, and may feel closer after Carolyn shared her own experiences.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then reassured and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up any misunderstanding, show support, and maintain a caring connection with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is receptive to Carolyn's support, and Carolyn feels hopeful that they are building a friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Marilyn's positive response and acceptance confirm that she is interested in connecting outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn wants to join the gathering and the friendship is developing positively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship by including Marilyn in a social gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite their friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn addresses this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed the friendship was progressing, but now she feels mixed signals because Marilyn remains professionally distant at work, leaving Carolyn disappointed and confused.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Carolyn learns that Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is willing to discuss and improve their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance may not be intentional, and Marilyn is open to resolving it and improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously reassured and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic directly and improve their professional collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. Marilyn agrees to team up for the new project proposal, says she is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have resolved their earlier misunderstandings and now understand each other's expectations and boundaries. She feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms Carolyn's belief that they have a stronger, more collaborative partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They understand each other better, and Marilyn is a willing and eager collaborator on future work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
